Name: MAP_GD_REGION_ID_PARAM_ST
Description: Region ID of each map. Row ID: map mAA_BB_CC_DD as AA·1,000,000 + BB·10,000 + CC·100, plus DD for overworld tiles. On an overworld tile the parent 512 m and 1024 m tiles are tried next; the first row found decides. No row: region 50 on DLC maps (m20–m22, m25, m28, m40–m43, m61), otherwise 0.

Fields.Name: Region ID
Fields.Description: Region this map belongs to. Weather first looks up WeatherParam row Region ID × 100 + weather type and falls back to the plain weather type row (e.g. region 20, weather 20 → WeatherParam 2020). Retail: 0–99 open-world regions, 1000 and up for legacy dungeons, caves and catacombs. MapGdRegionDrawParam rows use the same IDs.
